stock.description: Kinergy Corporation Ltd., along with its affiliates, delivers a broad spectrum of services encompassing contract manufacturing, design, engineering, and assembly for the electronics sector. Its global footprint includes operations in Singapore, the Philippines, the United States, the People's Republic of China, and Japan. The company organizes its activities into three primary divisions: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS), Original Design Manufacturing (ODM), and Investment. The EMS segment is responsible for manufacturing and distributing subsystems such as work-holders, sliders, and magazine handlers. It also produces complete machines, including dicing, lapping, lifter, and polishing units, alongside mechanical components specifically for the semiconductor processing equipment industry. This division additionally provides essential maintenance and commissioning services. In the ODM segment, Kinergy focuses on designing, developing, manufacturing, and selling advanced automated equipment, such as auto frame loaders, auto-buffing systems, and strip laser markers. It also supplies precision tools like encapsulation molds and dies, in addition to spare parts. The Investment segment manages funds and engages in investment activities involving equity securities and various financial funds. All of the company's offerings are marketed under the Kinergy brand. Furthermore, Kinergy participates in marketing and logistics operations, as well as the procurement of materials. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Singapore, the company was formerly known as Kinergy Ltd before rebranding to Kinergy Corporation Ltd. in December 2013.
